info.name: HOA Management System API — Springdale Village
info.description:
Complete REST API collection for the Springdale Village Homeowners Association Management System (Biñan City, Laguna).

**Base URL:** `{{base_url}}/api/v1`

**Authentication:** Laravel Sanctum — Bearer token. Run **Login** first; the token is auto-saved to `{{token}}` by the post-response script.

**Default seeded credentials:**
- SuperAdmin: `admin@springdale-hoa.ph`
- Board President: `rodrigo.aquino@springdale-hoa.ph`
- Treasurer: `lourdes.santos@springdale-hoa.ph`
- Resident: `carlos.reyes@gmail.com`
- Password (all): `Springdale@2026`

**Roles & permissions:**
- `super_admin` → full access to all modules
- `board_member` → financials, violations, announcements, maintenance, amenities, documents, meetings, reports
- `resident` → read own invoices/violations, submit maintenance, book amenities, view public docs/announcements, vote, update own profile
- `vendor` → read-only on assigned maintenance requests

**Modules (29 total):**
1. 🏥 Health Check
2. 🔐 Authentication
3. 👤 User Management
4. 🏠 Property Management
5. 💰 Financials — Invoices
6. 🚨 Violations & Appeals
7. 📢 Announcements
8. 🔧 Maintenance Requests
9. 🔄 Recurring Maintenance
10. 🏊 Amenities
11. 🚫 Amenity Blackouts
12. 📅 Amenity Bookings
13. 💹 Budget Management
14. 💧 Utility / Meter Billing
15. 🚗 Visitor Passes
16. 🗳️ Board Elections
17. 📄 Documents
18. 🗓️ Meetings & Voting
19. 🤝 Meeting Proxies
20. 🏛️ Board Positions
21. 👥 Committees
22. 🏪 Vendors
23. 🚘 Vehicles
24. 🐾 Pets
25. 🆘 Emergency Contacts
26. 📜 HOA Clearances
27. 📊 Reports & Summaries
28. 🔍 Audit Logs
29. 🙍 Resident Profile

**Uniform response envelope:**
```json
{ "success": true,  "message": "...", "data": { } }
{ "success": false, "message": "...", "errors": { } }
```

**Public identifiers:** All resources expose **UUID** as the public-facing `id`. Route parameters and request-body FK fields (`property_id`, `amenity_id`, etc.) all accept UUIDs.

**Stack:** Laravel 13 · SQLite · Sanctum 4 · PHP 8.3+ · Rate limiting: 60 req/min (API), 5 req/min (login)

item.name: 🏥 Health Check
item.description: Load-balancer probe. No authentication required. Returns `200 healthy` when the database is reachable, `503 degraded` otherwise.

request.description:
Returns service health status. No auth token required.

- `200` + `status: healthy` — all systems operational
- `503` + `status: degraded` — database unreachable

Use this as the load-balancer / uptime-monitor probe URL.

item.name: 🔐 Authentication
item.description:
Sanctum token-based auth. **Login** auto-saves the token to `{{token}}` so all subsequent requests are pre-authorized.

Password reset uses Laravel's built-in broker (email link). Email verification uses signed URL.

request.description:
Rate-limited: 5 attempts/min per IP.

**Role-based test users:**
- SuperAdmin: `admin@springdale-hoa.ph`
- Board President: `rodrigo.aquino@springdale-hoa.ph`
- Resident: `carlos.reyes@gmail.com`

All passwords: `Springdale@2026`

Sends a password-reset link to the given email address. No auth required.

Returns `200` regardless of whether the email exists (prevents user enumeration). In development (`MAIL_MAILER=log`), the reset link is written to `storage/logs/laravel.log`.

Resets the user's password using the token from the reset email. No auth required.

`token` is the value from the `?token=` query parameter in the reset link.
Resends the email verification link to the authenticated user. Requires a valid Bearer token.

variable.description: User's integer ID from the signed URL
SHA-1 hash of user email from the signed URL

request.description:
Verifies the user's email address via the signed link sent by the API. The full URL (including `expires` and `signature` query params) is provided in the verification email.

Copy the full URL from the email / log and paste it here.

item.name: 🚨 Violations & Appeals
item.description:
Violation logging, state-machine transitions, geotagged evidence, and resident appeals.

**State machine:** `draft → issued → appealed|paid|resolved`

**Authorization:** Create/update/evidence: `board_member`+. View: all. Submit appeal: any authenticated user.

request.description: Returns properties with 3 or more issued violations. **Board member / SuperAdmin only.**
Submits a formal appeal for a violation. Any authenticated user whose property is linked to the violation may appeal. Returns `409` if an appeal already exists.

item.name: 🔧 Maintenance Requests
item.description:
Residents submit maintenance issues; the board tracks, assigns, and resolves them.

**Status machine:** `submitted → in_review → in_progress → resolved → closed`

**Authorization:** Create: any. Update status / assign: `board_member`+. Upload photos: any.

body.raw:
{
  "property_id": "{{property_id}}",
  "category": "plumbing",
  "title": "Leaking Kitchen Faucet – Unit B1-L01",
  "description": "The kitchen faucet in my unit has been dripping constantly for the past three days. The leak is coming from the base of the faucet handle and has caused water damage to the cabinet underneath.",
  "priority": "normal"
}

request.description:
Transitions the maintenance request through its state machine. **Board member / SuperAdmin only.**

**Optional fields:**
- `assigned_to` — UUID of a vendor or board member
- `resolution_notes` — required when transitioning to `resolved`
- `actual_cost` — final cost in PHP (recorded when resolving)

formdata.description: One or more image files (JPEG/PNG). Select files from your machine.

request.description:
Attaches one or more photos to a maintenance request. Uses `multipart/form-data`.

Files are stored at `storage/app/maintenance/{uuid}/` using Laravel's local disk. The response includes the updated `photos` array of storage paths. **Any authenticated user** (resident or board) may upload photos on requests they have access to.

item.name: 🔄 Recurring Maintenance
item.description:
Scheduled maintenance templates (e.g. monthly pool cleaning, quarterly fire-safety inspection).

**Frequencies:** `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`, `quarterly`, `semi_annual`, `annual`

**Authorization:** Create/Update/Delete: `board_member`+. Spawn: `board_member`+. List/Show: all.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Monthly Swimming Pool Chemical Treatment",
  "description": "Monthly chlorination, pH balancing, and filter backwash of the HOA swimming pool. Contractor: Clearwater Pool Services.",
  "category": "common_area",
  "priority": "normal",
  "frequency": "monthly",
  "next_due_at": "2026-06-01",
  "assigned_to": null
}

request.description:
Immediately creates a new maintenance request from the recurring schedule template and advances `next_due_at` by one frequency period. Useful for manually triggering a scheduled task early.

The spawned request UUID is auto-saved to `{{maintenance_id}}`.

item.name: 📅 Amenity Bookings
item.description:
Facility reservation system.

**Booking status:** `pending → confirmed | cancelled`

**Business rules:**
- Time-slot conflict detection prevents double booking
- Blackout windows block new bookings
- Per-property monthly booking limit enforced (if set on amenity)
- Booking fee invoice auto-generated when `booking_fee > 0`

**Authorization:** Create: any. Confirm: `board_member`+. Cancel: booker or board.

item.name: 💹 Budget Management
item.description:
Annual budget planning by category. Actual vs budgeted variance is computed from paid invoices.

**Categories:** `maintenance`, `utilities`, `amenities`, `administrative`, `landscaping`, `security`, `contingency`, `other`

**Authorization:** Create/Delete: `board_member`+. List/Summary: `board_member`+.

query.description: Fiscal year (YYYY). Defaults to current year.

request.description:
Returns budgeted vs actual spend per category plus totals for the year. Actuals are derived from paid invoices mapped to budget categories.

**Response fields per category:** `budgeted`, `actual`, `variance` (negative = over budget).
Creates a budget entry, or updates it if one already exists for the same `fiscal_year` + `category` combination (upsert). **Board member / SuperAdmin only.**

item.name: 💧 Utility / Meter Billing
item.description:
Water, electricity, and gas meter readings with auto-bill generation.

**Utility types:** `water`, `electricity`, `gas`

**Authorization:** Create/Generate bill: `board_member`+. List/Show: all authenticated.

body.raw:
{
  "property_id": "{{property_id}}",
  "utility_type": "water",
  "meter_number": "WM-B1-L01-001",
  "current_reading": 1843.50,
  "reading_date": "2026-05-27",
  "rate_per_unit": 28.00,
  "fixed_charge": 50.00,
  "notes": "Meter read by Jose T. Bautista at 8:15 AM."
}

request.description:
Records a new meter reading. The service auto-fetches `previous_reading` from the last reading for the same property + utility_type if not provided. `consumption` = `current_reading - previous_reading`.

`rate_per_unit` and `fixed_charge` are stored with the reading for historical accuracy.

Generates a `water_bill` or `utility` invoice for the reading. Returns `409` if a bill has already been generated for this reading.

The created invoice UUID is linked back to the reading via `invoice_id`.

item.name: 🚗 Visitor Passes
item.description:
Pre-authorized visitor entry passes with unique access codes.

**Flow:** Resident creates pass → Security guard scans/enters code at gate → `check-in` marks pass as used.

**Authorization:** Create/List for own property: any authenticated. Check-in: `board_member`+. Delete: owner or board.

request.description: Creates a visitor pass with a randomly generated 6-character uppercase access code. The code is returned in the response and shared with the visitor / gate security.

response.name: 201 – Visitor Pass Created
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Visitor pass created.",
  "data": {
    "id": "<uuid>",
    "visitor_name": "Maria T. Santos",
    "vehicle_plate": "AAA 1234",
    "access_code": "XK7T2Q",
    "expected_at": "2026-06-01T14:00:00+00:00",
    "expires_at": "2026-06-01T22:00:00+00:00",
    "purpose": "Birthday celebration",
    "is_used": false,
    "used_at": null

}

variable.description: 6-char access code from the visitor pass

request.description: Marks a visitor pass as used. Returns `422` if already used or expired. Called by the guard's gate terminal when a visitor presents their access code.

item.name: 🗳️ Board Elections
item.description:
End-to-end board election management with FSM status control.

**Status machine:** `draft → nominations_open → voting_open → closed → certified`

**Positions:** `president`, `vice_president`, `secretary`, `treasurer`, `auditor`, `director`

**Authorization:** Create/Manage: `board_member`+. Nominate/Vote: any authenticated resident.

request.description: Returns the election with all nominations. Copy a nomination UUID from `data.nominations[0].id` into `{{nomination_id}}`.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Springdale Village HOA Board Election — FY 2026–2027",
  "description": "Annual election of the Board of Directors for the fiscal year 2026–2027. All registered homeowners in good standing are eligible to vote.",
  "nomination_deadline": "2026-06-30",
  "voting_open_at": "2026-07-05 08:00:00",
  "voting_close_at": "2026-07-07 20:00:00"
}

request.description:
Transitions the election through its state machine. **Board member / SuperAdmin only.**

**Valid transitions:** `draft → nominations_open → voting_open → closed → certified`
Submits a nomination for a candidate and position. Only allowed when election status is `nominations_open`. Returns `409` if the same nominee + position combination already exists.

Nominee accepts or declines their nomination. **Status values:** `accepted`, `rejected`, `withdrawn`.

Only `accepted` nominations are included in the vote tally and may receive votes.
Casts a vote for a nomination. One vote per position per voter per election. Returns `409` if already voted for this position.
Returns vote counts per nomination grouped by position. Available after election status reaches `closed`.

response.name: 200 – Election Tally

item.name: 📜 HOA Clearances

**Status machine:** `pending → approved | rejected`

**Authorization:** Create: any authenticated. Update status: `board_member`+. View: all.

request.description:

**Types:** `sale`, `transfer`, `good_standing`, `other`

item.name: 📊 Reports & Summaries
item.description:
Aggregated analytics for board members and admins.

**Authorization:** `board_member` or `super_admin` only.

All report endpoints are `GET`. The `export` endpoint returns a streaming CSV download.

request.description: Returns a high-level snapshot for the board dashboard: current month collection rate, open maintenance count, active violations, scheduled meetings, upcoming bookings, and delinquent property count.

Streams a CSV file download for the selected report type. In Postman, click **Send** then **Save Response → Save to a file**.

**Supported types:**
- `financial` — invoice ledger for the given month
- `violations` — violation log for trailing N months
- `maintenance` — maintenance request log
- `occupancy` — unit occupancy snapshot

**Response headers:** `Content-Type: text/csv`, `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="report-*.csv"`

item.name: 🔍 Audit Logs
item.description:
Immutable activity log for all significant create/update/delete actions.

**Authorization:** `super_admin` only.

request.description: Returns a paginated log of all auditable actions. **SuperAdmin only.**

variable.description: Entity type: invoice|violation|property|maintenance|user|etc.
UUID of the entity

request.description: Returns all audit entries for a specific entity (e.g. all changes made to a particular invoice). **SuperAdmin only.**

item.name: 🙍 Resident Profile
item.description:
Resident self-service — view and update own profile without board involvement.

**Authorization:** Any authenticated user (own profile only).

request.description:
Updates the authenticated user's name, phone, and/or password.

**To change password**, include all three password fields:
```json
{
  "current_password": "Springdale@2026",
  "password": "NewPassword@2027",
  "password_confirmation": "NewPassword@2027"
}
```

Returns `422` if `current_password` is incorrect.
